note: Eye textures for character eyeballs (Dramatis exports them; dramatis3d #3727). basic-eye and anime-eye: 256 × 256, the iris a disc of radius 48 centred at (128, 128) in three browns (#603813, #8c6239, #c69d6d) so it can be recoloured, a pupil, a darkening ring, the sclera filling the square (anime adds two glints). The SVGs are the art; the PNGs are rendered from them by dramatis3d's bin/eye-textures.ts. CC0, overriding the tonio namespace's CC BY.
